notes: Thai hotel booking confirmation, 1 page. Thai writes words without spaces and separates sentences/phrases with spaces: a line wrapped inside a sentence joins with NO space; each key sentence is one space-delimited Thai sentence. A TABLE BESIDE TEXT: the stay-details text column is on the left and the price table on the right; reading order is the text column first, then the table. The price table has line items, a subtotal, service charge, VAT, a grand total and two rows after it (deposit, balance). Cancellation list: TYPED markers '1.' '2.' '3.'; amenities list: CSS-drawn round markers (no glyph). Dates use the Buddhist era (2570 = 2027). Letterhead 3 lines; footer line and 'หน้า 1/1'. The title has slight letter spacing; it is given as plain text.
